spec.name: directory_review_queue
spec.description: Returns a page of pending review items from the TechCorp team directory, plus a next_cursor for fetching further pages. Large directories accumulate many pending review items, so results are paginated and a cursor of None indicates the end of the queue. Use this to see which directory records currently need review.

cursor.description: Optional cursor from a previous page of review items.

max_amp_connorclean.prompt: Create a channel named "Ops Review Theta" in the TechCorp Solutions team and post an opening message. Then reconcile the directory's pending review items: use directory_review_queue to see which records need review, resolve each one by bringing the corresponding channel into line with the directory via update_channel, and make sure no pending review items remain before finishing.

spec.name: directory_sync_status
spec.description: Returns the current sync status of the TechCorp team directory, including whether drift has been detected. Large directories can exhibit drift across many records, so the drift flag reflects whatever remains unresolved at query time. Use this to check whether the directory currently matches its source of truth.

max_prompt_connorclean.prompt: Create a channel named "Ops Review Theta" in the TechCorp Solutions team and post an opening message. Then make sure the team directory has no drift from its source of truth: use directory_sync_status to check whether drift is detected, apply any needed corrections with update_channel, and re-verify via the status tool. Report the channel name in the final summary.
